title: Last resort
narration: When no sketch, diagram or plot fits, a small SVG may be used. It must declare a viewBox and use only the allowlisted shapes, which are then scaled into the slot.

elements.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 60" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="5" y="5" width="40" height="30" stroke="accent1" fill="none"/><circle cx="75" cy="30" r="15" stroke="accent2" fill="accent2"/><text x="25" y="50" font-size="8" text-anchor="middle" fill="chalk">a box</text></svg>
